Title: Anil's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Anil - 33 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Suresh - 62 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The ghat - stone steps, the flowing river

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Anil stands in the courtyard. Suresh stands near him.]

Suresh: "Let's do something fun today."

[Anil dances at his sister's wedding.]

Anil: "Oh wow!"

[Anil showers flower petals on the couple.]

Anil (surprised): "Dad, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Anil stands in the living room. Suresh stands near him.]

Anil: "Dad, look over here."

[Anil coughs in the thick smoke and crawls to the door.]

Anil: "Okay, Dad."

[Anil throws a bucket of water on the fire.]

Anil: "Oh wow!"

Scene 3: The ghat - Day

[Anil stands on the ghat. Suresh stands near him.]

Anil: "Dad, look over here."

[Anil drowns in the river.]

Suresh: "We will never forget you."
